verdict.what: a red-brick gabled market hall with a stepped-gable front
verdict.style: medieval/Flemish-inspired civic hall, red brick with stone plinth and timber-look corners
verdict.looks: A long, low-to-mid hall with a steep dark-brown stepped roof (crow-step tiers) over a red-brick (terracotta/red wool-like) wall. Front and back gables are stepped, with a small dark door-like opening up top on the front and a light rectangular window on the back. Corners are tan, carved-panel pillars. A grey stone-brick plinth runs along the base over a darker wood-plank footing. The front has a light grey portal frame with a checkered white-and-wood floor visible inside, plus a row of fence-post railings across the front. Side wall has evenly spaced light-grey window slots and a grey stone course at the base. Materials are simple full blocks with light and dark shading on the faces; no visible gaps through the walls.
verdict.summary: A solid, legible red-brick guildhall with a convincing stepped roof and a clear front portal; it just needs the side windows and front railing tidied so the walls read as finished rather than sparse.
